MPCE-E582 store_nonce_invalid (store)
exit:     6
message:  the engine refused the store nonce: missing, all zero, or equal to a key
next:     Nothing was created. A new store needs a fresh random 16-byte nonce, never reused and never equal to its keys: the kit makes one for every store, so this is a kit bug: report it.
rule:     the MPCE seam (stable codes)
verbs:    a host call (no verb)
status:   live
